description: Source code for the pcap_file_writer class, responsible for writing PCAP files including headers, PDUs, and associated metadata.

classes.name: pcap_file_writer
classes.description: Class for writing PCAP files, managing file headers, data packets, and metadata.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a PCAP file for writing, initializes headers.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the output stream to ensure data is written.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the PCAP file, ensuring data is saved.

methods.name: write_pdu_header
methods.description: Writes a packet header with timestamp and length info.

methods.name: write_exported_pdu_header
methods.description: Writes metadata header for exported PDU, including dissector name.

methods.name: write_pdu
methods.description: Writes a PDU (protocol data unit) to the file.
